caption: The drawing depicts the exterior of a building featuring architectural details including a wrought iron staircase and balcony. The left portion of the image shows a flat balcony with an ornate railing that includes decorative geometric and curvilinear patterns. Above and behind the balcony are two sets of tall, closed wooden shutters divided into multiple panels. The right side of the composition features a stairway rising diagonally from the bottom-center to the upper right, bordered by a matching wrought iron railing, also decorated with geometric and circular motifs. The entire scene is rendered in a monochrome color scheme, composed of small dots in black ink on a light, cream-colored paper, achieved through a stippling technique. The background features another set of closed shutters, and areas of the drawing vary in tone based on the density of stippling, with lighter and darker regions suggesting light and shadow. There are no people or additional objects present in the scene.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
